name: ruling-9-a-switch-key-is-predicted-as-wrapped
reference: spec 0.56 ruling 9; 0.20 rulings 33 and 37: the line of probe.x would write 12 wrapped to 2, so case 2 is predicted; nothing there names p.1, so p.1 is 0 (00), x is written 02, which selects case 2, then the const aa. Predicting 12 would select else, whose y sets p.1 (80); x is then not written, and the absent key selects else: 8007, also stable.
